_comment: Race catalog (real data drives the schema). Each race has stat modifiers applied at character creation, an optional XP curve override (Humans level faster), and an `abilities` list of innate Ability ids granted to members of this race. Ability records (name, description, default params) live in abilities.json — this file only carries the reference. v1 called this field `effects` and pointed at Effect ids; v2 renamed it to `abilities` and migrated the records into the dedicated Ability catalog.

races.name: Human
races.description: Versatile and adaptable, humans excel in no single area but have no weaknesses. They learn quickly and level up faster than other races.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stout and hardy, dwarves are natural miners and warriors with keen underground senses.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small and nimble, halflings are surprisingly resilient and hard to hit.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Graceful and keen-minded, elves have a natural affinity for magic and sharp senses.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Clever and curious, gnomes combine a knack for tinkering with innate magical talent.
